entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello David. I... I hope you can help. I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not broken or anything. It's just... we had a family emergency right after it arrived. My husband was in the hospital for an unexpected surgery. It all happened so fast.
I'm very sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly stressful. I can definitely try to sort this out for you.

Thank you. And on top of that, my daughter's military deployment got moved up, so I've been completely overwhelmed. I looked at the website and saw something about 10 days... I'm past that now. Can't you just help me? I don't understand these policies.
I completely understand. Please don't worry. Let me just pull up our official return guidelines. One moment please.

Okay, thank you for holding. I've just checked our knowledge base. I can see you received the item 18 days ago, and our policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
That's correct. You are well within the 90-day window. As long as the item is in its original condition, we can process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried this was going to be another difficult thing to deal with.
Not at all. I'm happy I could clear that up for you. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you again.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get easier for you and your family soon. Have a good day.
